note: Eighteen rounds. The first six found defects that were real and reproduced here before being fixed, including two that would have passed a defective manuscript (the scope gate never read the abstract; a plural figure citation was invisible), two that would have failed a correct one (a [[marker]] in the scope paragraph; a count after a comma read as a figure number), and one crash introduced by a fix in round 11 and caught in round 12. Rounds beyond that returned lexical edge cases.
unresolved: A multi-letter panel group -- 'figures 1(a-c)' with the letters inside one bracket, or '1a,b' -- ends the citation at the group, so a number after it is not read. Not a form this manuscript uses. Documented in check_figures_are_first_cited_in_order.
A figure of another work is excluded only when what follows looks bibliographic ('of Sechopoulos et al', 'of TG-195'); 'figure 3 of the manual' is read as ours. Documented in the same place.

The scope gate traces the paragraph's prose into the build; what a [[...]] marker rendered to is not traced (check_markers_resolved covers the values), and the bounding-word list is a list. Documented in the gate.
AI-Check v1 runs standard unittest only, so the 248 pytest tests in tests/ and the image, DOCX and figure checks were run locally and are not part of this verdict.
